allowed_value_rules.boolean: Stated or not stated. There is nothing else to say.
allowed_value_rules.code: A coded value issued under a code system. The code system is chosen for the project or region; the value must be a real code under it, not merely non-empty.
allowed_value_rules.compound: Several named parts stated together, such as width and height. A missing part is refused.
allowed_value_rules.dictionary_item: Names an entry in a shared CMM dictionary. A value that is not in that dictionary is refused.
allowed_value_rules.enum: A closed list. Only the values the parameter names are valid.
allowed_value_rules.held: No reviewed value source yet. The parameter asks the reviewer one question; no value can be checked and publication is blocked until it is answered.
allowed_value_rules.integer: A whole count with a unit. A fraction is refused.
allowed_value_rules.number: A measured value with a unit. Anything not a number is refused.
allowed_value_rules.open_text: Deliberately free text, with a stated reason it stays open. Used where a closed list would have to be invented.

general_rules.text: measure the actual work to its finished dimensions. Do not add waste, cutting loss, bulking or tolerance unless an item expressly says so.
